item.text: I’ll inspect the router implementation and tests first, then patch the smallest surface that owns matching behavior. After that I’ll run the test suite and any focused tests that reveal failures.

The codebase is very small: matching is currently an exact string comparison in `src/router.mjs`, and tests already include named params. I’m reading the test expectations and package setup before editing so the behavior lands in the existing contract.

I’m going to implement segment-based matching rather than regexing the whole string. That keeps decoding per segment sane, lets `*rest` capture multiple segments, and avoids accidentally treating interior double slashes as trailing-slash normalization.

The matcher now handles static, `:param`, and wildcard segments in one pass. I’m adding tests for the requested edge cases, including malformed URL escapes so bad input fails cleanly instead of throwing.
The focused tests now cover named params, decoding, wildcard rest captures, zero-length rest, trailing slashes, and basic mismatches. I’m running the full benchmark check next.
